stations.title: Your code
stations.gap: Each kind has its own copy

captions: The booking types are in. Dele wants the newest note on the workshop board.
One shared copy takes any list, but what comes back is unknown.
You write generic helpers that keep the real type, in three tasks.
Now the newest note comes back as a note, text and all.
One helper per job, no casts. The type that goes in comes out.
